label: Save a separate gradient for each workspace in light and dark mode. Edit each mode to customize it. Follows Zen appearance (and your system when set to Auto). Temporarily overrides Dynamic Theme and Lightness Inversion. Disabled by default.

Move each color point freely without moving the others. Overrides color harmonies while enabled. Adding or removing points keeps the remaining colors in place. Brightness, opacity and texture controls still apply to the whole gradient.
Choose Active Tab colors directly in the gradient picker: click a color swatch or + for any color. Auto restores the normal tab style. Light and dark appearances remember different colors.
Automatically switch between light and dark mode based on gradient lightness. Requires Zen light/dark mode set to auto.
Keep sidebar and toolbar text tied to the browser light/dark mode instead of the gradient brightness.
Invert gradient lightness to match the active browser theme, for example darker gradients in dark mode.
